XDP eBPF unit tests for packet redirect and pass cases.

# Purpose
`test_xdp_ebpf` is a Linux-only test program for an XDP eBPF flow. It loads an XDP program with `BPF_PROG_LOAD`, creates an `XSKMAP`, opens an `AF_XDP` socket, and then runs the program with `BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN`. The file checks the program result for many packet forms and header values, including Ethernet, IPv4, UDP, GRE, and several imported packet fixtures such as TCP, ARP, ICMP, DNS, and QUIC frames.

The main test logic is in [`run_tests`](<#run_tests>), which builds packet buffers in memory and calls [`prog_test`](<#prog_test>) to compare the returned XDP action with the expected action. It verifies redirect and pass cases for destination port, IPv4 protocol, destination IP, Ethertype, and IPv4 header length, and it also checks packet fixtures with and without GRE encapsulation. The [`main`](<#main>) function creates the map and socket, loads the generated eBPF code twice with different redirect target settings, runs the full test set for each case, and then closes resources before reporting success.
